result.prompt: A print-ready A4 portrait flyer, 210:297 aspect ratio, shown straight-on with perfectly square edges, filling the frame without mockup scenery. Warm retro jazz-club design on subtly speckled ivory paper, with burnt orange as the dominant colour, deep espresso brown, muted mustard, and small teal accents. A large illustrated vintage microphone occupies the centre-right, its brushed brass grille rendered with bold screen-printed curves and imperfect ink registration; its cable loops downward into rhythmic abstract shapes resembling musical improvisation. A burnt-orange oval spotlight behind the microphone creates the focal point, while staggered geometric blocks and sparse starbursts add mid-century energy without clutter. The only lettering reads exactly “Open Mic Night · Friday 7pm · The Blue Door”, arranged as one coherent typographic composition: “Open Mic Night” dominates the upper third in oversized, expressive condensed display lettering, with the remaining wording and separating middle dots continuing below in a clear, generously spaced sans serif. Keep all lettering comfortably inside print-safe margins. Flat graphic lighting, warm cream highlights, subtle paper grain, crisp readable typography, and tactile two-colour letterpress character rather than glossy digital effects.
